title: Lucky Dog
meta_description: Private Pool, Near Beach & State Park- Lucky Dog by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Lucky Dog by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 142 Savelle Drive Details: Lucky Dog is an inviting coastal retreat located in the private Gulf Trace neighborhood of Grayton Beach. Offering approximately 1,998 square feet of interior living space and an additional 2,800 square feet of outdoor living, this spacious home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with four bedrooms and four full baths. Surrounded by the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park, the home offers multiple indoor and outdoor gathering spaces designed for relaxing and enjoying time together along 30A. Outdoor living is a highlight at Lucky Dog, with a private heated pool, gas fire pit, ping pong table, screened porch, and multiple covered porches overlooking the surrounding natural landscape. Private neighborhood beach access is approximately a four-minute walk from the home, and Gulf Trace offers two private beach accesses along a beautiful stretch of shoreline surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park. With its private pool, generous outdoor spaces, and peaceful Gulf Trace setting, Lucky Dog provides an ideal home base for your Grayton Beach getaway. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 4-Minute Walk to Private Neighborhood Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (2) in Carport and (2) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available: Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker -Private Heated Pool* -(2) Private Neighborhood Beach Accesses -Borders Grayton Beach State Park -Gas Fire Pit -Ping Pong Table -Screened Porch -Multiple Covered Porches -Outdoor Gas Grill -Full-Size Crib Available** *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per night and must be arranged prior to arrival. *The pool uses an electric heater that will not operate when ambient temperatures fall below 55 degrees. Pool heating is not recommended during colder weather. **Crib sheets are not provided. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 4 Baths Ground Floor: -Carport -Private Heated Pool -Gas Fire Pit -Ping Pong Table Second Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 2 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunks with Detached Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Laundry Room -Screened Porch -Covered Porch with Grayton Beach State Park Views Third Floor: -Bedroom 3 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Detached Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Covered Porch -Full-Size Crib Available in Master Bedroom Closet* *Crib sheets are not provided. Please Note: *Golf carts and on-street parking are strictly prohibited within the Gulf Trace neighborhood. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
